svg.text: RACK-SCALE SUPERNODE ARCHITECTURE: NVIDIA GB200/GB300 NVL72 VS. 8-GPU HGX H200/B200
GB200 NVL72 (72-Way 1,800 GB/s NVLink 5 + Grace C2C) Delivers 7,420 Tok/s/GPU at 5.2ms TPOT
72-GPU Frontier MoE Comparison: Tier 1 9x HGX H100 ($0.56/1M) vs. Tier 2 9x HGX H200 ($0.25/1M) vs. Tier 4 1x NVL72 ($0.13/1M)
⛔ The 8-GPU HGX Boundary on Giant MoE Models
1. The `18x` Bandwidth Cliff Above 8 GPUs on Standard HGX:
• Inside 1 HGX box, 8 GPUs talk at `900–1,800 GB/s` NVLink; but
scaling MoE `EP=64/72` across 8–9 boxes drops to `50–100 GB/s` RDMA!
2. x86 PCIe Gen5 Host-to-GPU Bottleneck (`64 GB/s` per GPU):
• Offloading KV Cache or RL weights to x86 DDR5 is throttled by
PCIe Gen5 x16 (`64 GB/s` unidirectional per GPU)
3. Optical Transceiver Power & Cost Overhead Across 9 Nodes:
• Requires 72 external 400G/800G optical transceivers for intra-EP
9x 8-GPU HGX Cross-Node EP=72 Limitations:
• Tier 1 HGX H100: 980 tok/s/GPU, 21.6ms TPOT ($0.56/1M)
• Tier 2 HGX H200: 2,380 tok/s/GPU, 13.6ms TPOT ($0.25/1M)
• Host DRAM Offload Bandwidth: Capped at 64 GB/s per GPU
🏆 Tier 4: GB200 / GB300 NVL72 Rack-Scale Supernode
1. 72-GPU Single `NVLink 5` Domain (`130 TB/s` Copper Backplane):
• 18 NVSwitch trays connect all 72 Blackwell GPUs at `1,800 GB/s`
per GPU over lossless passive copper—`EP=72` never touches RDMA!
2. Grace-Blackwell `NVLink-C2C` (`450 GB/s` Coherent LPDDR5X/GPU):
• Each Grace CPU links to 2 GPUs at `900 GB/s` (`450 GB/s/GPU` =
`7x` faster than PCIe Gen5!), adding `17 TB` rack LPDDR5X KV pool!
3. Clear Selection Boundary (`125 kW DLC` vs. `<=50 kW` Facility):
• Choose `NVL72` for `>=405B/671B` MoE if DC has `125kW` DLC
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (GB200 NVL72):
• Per-GPU Goodput: 7,420 tok/s/GPU (3.12x vs. H200, 7.57x vs. H100)
• P99 Decode TPOT: 5.2 ms (192 tok/s/user!) | C2C: 450 GB/s/GPU
• Cost per 1M Tokens: $0.13 / 1M (-76.8% vs. Tier 1)
